name: Notes and memory pack
about: Give an Imp a long memory and a notes folder. Memory keeps a small knowledge graph of people, projects and facts across chats. Files lets it read and write inside one folder only. Make a folder called ImpNotes in your Documents first, or edit the folder in the tool's settings after adding.

registry.author: Imp community
registry.summary: A knowledge-graph memory plus read/write access to a single notes folder.
